description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Ezreal''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit by his [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]], lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 5 times.
description.text: Innate: Ezreal generates a stack of Rising Spell Force for each enemy hit by his abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 5 times.

description2.raw: '''Rising Spell Force:''' For each stack, '''Ezreal''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 10% '''bonus''' attack speed, up to a maximum of 50%.
description2.text: Rising Spell Force: For each stack, Ezreal gains  10% bonus attack speed, up to a maximum of 50%.

notes.raw: * ''Rising Spell Force'' will stack even if the abilities hit were blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shields]].
notes.text: Rising Spell Force will stack even if the abilities hit were blocked by spell shields.
